title: Shining Creek | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked beside a year-round creek and framed by towering pines, this modern Alpine Meadows retreat offers a seamless blend of sleek design and natural serenity. Vaulted ceilings and expansive windows flood the home with light, while black and white tones, warm wood accents, and designer furnishings create a polished yet welcoming atmosphere. Centered around a dramatic stone fireplace, the open living area flows onto a balcony with creekside views, inviting guests to relax, dine, and soak in the alpine air. A chef’s kitchen equipped with high-end appliances and marble countertops makes entertaining effortless, complemented by a family-style dining area that brings everyone together. Spanning three thoughtfully designed levels, the home features five bedrooms, including a luxurious primary suite with a spa-inspired ensuite and dedicated workspace. A lower-level media lounge with a wet bar and direct access to the private hot tub sets the scene for cozy movie nights and après-ski relaxation. Every detail—from the bunk room for kids to the well-appointed mudroom and two-car garage—has been curated for comfort and convenience. Located just minutes from Alpine Meadows and Palisades Tahoe, with year-round trails and a seasonal ski shuttle nearby, this mountain modern escape delivers the best of Tahoe in every season.
